leverage.exposure: None. Balance is positive, no leveraged position is open, no offer is live, and the matchday lock is more than five days away. Nothing is time-critical this run.

binding_gap: There is no positional hole — the eleven fill a legal 4-3-3 exactly. The binding constraint is the unwind ceiling, and it is severe: at eleven players a purchase buys the right to exactly one sale, and the largest sale that does not cost fielded points is Lokonga. That caps today's purchase at roughly a fifth of what spending power suggests is available. Until the squad grows past eleven with a large sellable body in it, every defender worth having on this board is unreachable, and reading spending power as the budget is the single easiest way to open a negative position that scores zero for a whole matchday.

verdict.headline: No action.
verdict.detail: No action. The squad is complete, legal and unlevered, nobody is flagged, and nothing on the board is both affordable and better than what it would displace. The one number that matters this run is not spending power — it is the unwind ceiling, and every player on this board with a real points case sits far above it. Sit still.

sell.reason: Nothing to sell. The standing Lokonga sale is now formally off rather than merely deferred: it existed only as the unwind leg of the Rohr purchase, and Rohr was lost at auction overnight to David, so the condition in the block that cancels the sale outright is satisfied. Selling him now would drop the squad below eleven and trigger the shortfall penalty for nothing. He stays, on those grounds and not on merit — he remains the designated funding lever the moment a buy ever lands. Widmer likewise stays: he is the designated funding sale once the squad is legal at twelve, and the squad is not at twelve.

standing.why: THE UNWIND LEG OF BUY Bsmq4uu - CONDITIONAL, AND THE CONDITION IS NOT OPTIONAL. WHY HIM AND NOT CONTE, the only other candidate: on points they are a coin flip (Lokonga ap 44 v Conte ap 47, so Conte is fractionally better and the Lokonga route is worth +3 fielded points because it keeps Widmer 29 in a 5-2-3 rather than dropping Conte 47 from a 5-3-2 - 1283 v 1280). Conte is RISING hard: mvt 1, sdmvt +1.284.273, tfhmvt +93.437. Sell the decaying asset and keep the appreciating one. SELECTION CUTS THE OTHER WAY AND IS DELIBERATELY OVERRIDDEN: Lokonga is a confirmed HSV starter (no news dated 04.09.2026 or later; note the hsv.de "Verletzungsupdate zu Sambi Lokonga" ankle-ligament story is 09.02.2026 = LAST SEASON and was correctly discarded again this run), while Conte was BENCHED by Hoffenheim v Dortmund on 05.09.2026 (sport.de liveticker; rotated for Lemperle and Rots). That argues for selling Conte instead. It is outweighed by the mv trajectories: Conte benched but appreciating is still the better asset to hold, and a start is not points. FORMATION DEPENDENCY, THE ONE THING THAT COULD FORCE THE SWITCH: this route leaves 1GK/5DEF/2MID/3ATT and needs 5-2-3 to be selectable. If the app does not offer 5-2-3, sell CONTE instead (9.292.405, leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2, definitely legal, 1280 fielded, and the bid was sized so that route also stays positive at +45.172). Inside that envelope the board offers only unfit bodies (Karaman, Leopold, Prass, Emre Can with a cruciate), bodies with no scoring appearance at all (Chandler, Porath, Duric, Jakic — whom Ligainsider lists as not in the Augsburg squad — and the backup keeper Boss), and two manager asks priced well over market value whose players barely beat the man they would replace (Ulrich, Vidovic). standing.name: Maximilian Rohr

The 20:00Z tick lifted Rohr's mv 9.726.134 -> 9.863.244 (+1,41%), so the standing 10.250.000 bid fell from +5,39% to +3,92% over mv without anyone doing anything. prc is now 9.863.244 and the offer still clears it (ofc 1, ofs = Georg Kitz alone, uop 10.250.000), so nothing is broken - but a bid that drifts DOWN in premium terms while a listing runs is exactly the passive posture H5om1wi condemns. This is a KICKBASE listing = highest-bid-wins at expiry, so raising buys win probability outright (unlike a manager ask, Hlovt4t seller's choice). exs 15148 = resolves ~2026-09-06T00:57Z, roughly 4,2h out. (5) NEWS RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-05, ALL DATED IN PERIOD: eurosport.de live-lineup for Gladbach v Elversberg 05.09.2026 names Rohr in the CONFIRMED Elversberg back four; ligainsider 04.09.2026 "Wagner: Vertrauen in bewaehrtes Abwehr-Trio"; ligainsider 31.08.2026 clears the MD1 substitution as exhaustion, not injury; he is ABSENT from ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte fetched this run; contract to 2028, no exit risk; st 0. p 202 / ap 101 over two starts. 97,7k per fielded point at the new mv - better than every outfielder Georg owns except Gregoritsch, ter Horst and Onyeka. Fielded eleven 1226 -> 1283 (+57) on the Lokonga unwind. (6) SEQUENCING IS UNCHANGED AND NOT OPTIONAL: RAISE FIRST, SELL AFTER. A lost auction after a sale leaves the squad at 10 and the -100 penalty. Mechanically this is remove_offer then place_offer at 10.700.000 - GEORG EXECUTES, this task never places trades. (7) FIXTURE CAVEAT FOR THE NEXT RUN, NEWLY DERIVED: the lineup `os` field is the MD3 OPPONENT, not MD2. Elversberg's MD3 is v BAYERN (Minjae's os is ELV, mirroring it), so Rohr's MD2 haul of ~115 came at Gladbach and his first Georg matchday is the hardest fixture on the board. standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: CONDITIONAL ON THE 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z MARKET-VALUE TICK, WHICH IS 1h13m AWAY AND WILL VERY LIKELY PUT THE LIVE 10.250.000 OFFER UNDERWATER. This does not revise BUY Bsmq4uu (still open, still correct at the current ask); it is the contingency that Bsmq4uu itself asked the next run to price. STATE OF THE OFFER AT 18:45Z: listing prc 9.726.134 = exactly mv, ofc 1 with Georg alone in ofs at 10.250.000 = +5,39%, exs 22363 resolving ~2026-09-06T01:07Z. WHY THE TICK IS THE PROBLEM: Rohr posted ~115 points in MD2 (p 87 -> 202, ap 101) and mvt reads 1 (rising). Every Kickbase listing observed in this ledger carries prc == mv exactly, so the ask moves with the tick. The measured magnitude of a big-matchday tick, taken from this run's own squad sdmvt figures, is +9% to +34%: ter Horst scored 143 and moved +2.244.127 on 8.797.749 = +25,5%; Onyeka scored 139 and moved +2.024.477 on 9.286.468 = +21,8%; Conte scored 106 and moved +1.284.273 on 9.292.405 = +13,8%; Gregoritsch 195 -> +11,8%; Minjae 110 -> +11,8%; Matsima 138 -> +9,0%. Rohr at ~115 sits squarely in that band, so a post-tick mv of roughly 10,7M to 12,2M is the central expectation and +5,39% of headroom does not cover it. THE DECISION RULE, so the 20:45Z run does not re-derive it: re-read list_market at 20:05Z. (a) If the new prc is at or under 10.250.000, do nothing - the standing offer still clears. (b) If the new prc is above 10.250.000 but the affordability ceiling still covers it, RAISE to the ceiling. (c) If the new prc exceeds the ceiling, the buy is DEAD on affordability and the offer should be pulled rather than left to fail. THE CEILING MUST BE RECOMPUTED AT 20:05Z, NOT REUSED FROM HERE - this is the trap in this call. It is cash 1.002.767 plus the single sale a post-buy squad of 12 permits, and BOTH unwind legs move at the same tick in OPPOSITE directions. Lokonga is mvt 2 FALLING with sdmvt -1.125.317 and scored only 44, so his 9.731.816 will probably shrink; Conte is mvt 1 RISING with sdmvt +1.284.273 and scored 106, so his 9.292.405 will probably grow. Take the LARGER of the two post-tick values: selling Lokonga leaves 1/5/2/3 = 5-2-3 fielding 1283, selling Conte leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2 fielding 1280, a three-point difference that is not worth defending against a cash difference of a million. 10.734.583 recorded here is the PRE-TICK Lokonga-route ceiling and is a placeholder for that computation. WHY RAISING IS RIGHT RATHER THAN MERELY TOLERABLE, WHICH THE HEADLINE PRICE HIDES: the purchase is not P for 101 points, it is (P minus the unwind proceeds) for the NET points gain. Post-buy-and-unwind the eleven goes 1226 -> 1283, i.e. +57 fielded points, for a net cash outlay of P - 9.731.816. At the current 10.250.000 that is 518.184 for +57 = 9,1k per marginal point; even at the full 10.734.583 ceiling it is 1.002.767 for +57 = 17,6k per marginal point. Set that against the bar this ledger has been applying to everything else on the board - Conte 107k, Kosugi 351k rejected, Demirovic 465k, Robin Koch 184k gross - and Rohr is an order of magnitude better than anything else available. So the ceiling is a hard money constraint and NOT a judgement that the extra premium is unattractive: pay it if it fits. AND PER H5om1wi, RAISING ON A KICKBASE LISTING BUYS WIN PROBABILITY, because these are highest-bid-wins rather than seller's choice - this is the exact configuration in which the Makengo bid was held at +13,03% and lost to +60,76%. ofc 1 now is a snapshot, not a forecast, and the listing sits six hours out, which is the late-contest window that doctrine describes. NEWS VERIFIED THIS RUN, ALL DATED 05.09.2026: he started at CB and played the full 90 in Elversberg's 4:3 win at Gladbach (news.de match report, 05.09.2026, no substitution and no injury noted); Ligainsider's Elversberg page has him in the XI and Elversberg's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte entries are only Seifert and Zimmerschied; he is absent from Ligainsider's league-wide injury table read this run. st 0. He is now 3/3 starts. Fitness and selection are not in question - only the price is.
